zh.explain: 贤能代代相传，都过着丰衣足食的生活，这都是天的护佑。父母安康全家欢乐，饿了吃，渴了喝，困倦就睡。
divination: 就像用竹节引泉水一样，一节接一节，连续不断。贤能的人会筹谋未来。
因此，无不有令人欣喜欢悦的结果。
items: 记得兑现曾对菩萨许下的承诺
zh.summary: 此卦接竹引泉之象。所祈求之事若能想得更远则大吉大利。

verse: A virtuous father will teach his descendants virtues.
Heaven will provide plenty for their wants and needs.
The elders in the family are happy and fulfilled.
Hunger is filled, thirst is quenched, the tired may rest,
interpretation: Like bamboo poles arranged to connect to a spring, this will survive generations.  Whatever an upright man pursues, it will be filled with great joy and happiness.
meaning: Stack the bamboo to lead towards a stream.
What you aspire will be fortuitously achieved.
en.explain: It is the blessing from Heaven that a virtuous father can pass on his virtues to descendants with generations all living a life of abundance. Parents are healthy, the family is happy, with sufficient food to eat, drink and can rest when tired.
divination: It is like drawing water from spring by joining sections of bamboo together.  The able man knows to plan for his future.  Hence the ending is always filled with joy and happiness.
items: Remember to repay your vows made to Bodhisattvas
You will receive help from benefactors
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. en verse last line ends with a comma (not a period) as printed. zh explain starts '贤能代代相传' as printed.
